target_domain: Engineered living materials and synthetic biology for programming nonliving matter with living cellular functions
core_gap: Current methods separately achieve protein-material conjugation, intracellular metabolite-responsive regulation, and light-controlled cell transport, but they do not provide a unified, predictive, closed-loop programming framework that coordinates molecular interfacing, cellular sensing, genetic regulation, and extracellular matrix remodeling into a single living material system while preserving viability, orthogonality, and spatiotemporal control.
